articles.summary: Granite Ridge Resources, Inc. (“Granite Ridge” or the “Company”) (NYSE: GRNT) today reported financial and operating results for the third quarter of 2025. Third Quarter 2025 Highlights Grew daily production 27% to 31,925 barrels of oil equivalent (“Boe”) per day (51% oil), from 25,177 Boe per day for the third quarter of 2024. articles.title: Granite Ridge Resources, Inc. Reports Third Quarter 2025 Results and Declares Quarterly Cash Dividend
